newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-OGRIZOVIC THINKING OVER OFFICIAL COMPLAINT AGAINST WRIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OGRIZOVIC THINKING OVER OFFICIAL COMPLAINT AGAINST WRIGHT.

text.p: Coventry goalkeeper Steve Ogrizovic will decide in the next 24 hours whether to lodge a complaint with the English Football Association (F.A.) over his clash with Arsenal's Ian Wright at Highbury on Saturday.
Ogrizovic suffered a broken nose and an arm injury in the second-half incident and afterwards he launched a blistering verbal attack on the Gunners striker, blaming him of hurting him deliberately.
Video evidence of the incident appeared to be inconclusive.
Wright is currently facing an F.A. charge for alleged remarks about Sheffield Wednesday manager David Pleat.
Ogrizovic, who has declared himself fit to play in Tuesday's League Cup tie at Gillingham, said: "I will have a chat with (manager) Ron Atkinson and then decide what to do about what happened."
An F.A. spokeswoman said: "The referee hasn't taken any action, so either he hasn't seen anything or doesn't think anything that happened warranted any action.
"We have to see whether Coventry are going to complain and so far we haven't received anything from them."
